raw_brief: Senior Product Owner at Epiq (Hyderabad, hybrid), 7+ years. Capability signals: product vision & strategy, backlog ownership & Agile delivery, hands-on AI fluency, stakeholder engagement, quality/risk, AI/ML experience, legal-tech domain. Recruiter listed 13 legal-services target companies; exclude current Epiq employees.

archetype.rationale: 'Product Owner' carries strong occupational meaning; the title family is the primary gate and capability signals validate via evidence. Proven by the role-first experiment (0 -> 2.0-tail, 95-100% product).

requirements.name: role_family (Product Owner family)
requirements.note: fuzzy (.) OR; title-defined so this is the primary gate

requirements.name: seniority Senior
requirements.note: enforced negatively via exec-title exclusions; level_fit demotion handled at admission (Phase 1a)

requirements.name: target companies (13 legal firms)
requirements.note: OFF as a hard filter by default: proven to starve the pool (current-hard -> 2 candidates). No verified provider preference mechanism (NL injection proven inert). Recruiter may opt into a hard relationship(current/past/any) x strength if they truly mean 'alumni of these firms'. Default: do not gate.

requirements.name: product vision / backlog / Agile / AI fluency / stakeholder / quality / AI-ML / legal-tech
requirements.note: evidence signals: NL relevance context + RequirementJudge verification; never hard provider filters

requirements.name: work mode Hybrid
requirements.note: person_search cannot filter work_mode -> disclose context-only

known_good: Senior Product Owner/Manager in Hyderabad, 7+ yrs, evidence of product vision/backlog/Agile; target-company membership is a plus, not a gate
known_bad: confident level_fit above/below (Director in a Senior search) -> demote at admission
legal/project managers at target firms with no product evidence (the original failure)
validation_note: Role-first experiment (2026-10-01): title gate took the 2.0 tie-mass to 0 and product density to 95-100%. Hard current-company filter starves the pool (-> 2). Company OFF by default is the correct default FOR THIS JD; generalization across the regression set still pending (Phase 5).
